title: Vow Collar 2026 Standalone Edition Release
author: Architect of Chaos
summary: The definitive BDSM, FinDom, and RLV management collar has completed QA testing and is now entering in-world release.
content:
### The Next Era of Second Life Restraint & FinDom Technology

We are proud to announce the official release of the **[Control & Chaos] Vow Collar Standalone Edition**.

Engineered from the ground up for zero script delay, the 2026 Vow Collar integrates deep into the Chaos Manor ecosystem while operating as an elite standalone collar for any region in Second Life.

### Key Capabilities

* **Ultra-Fast LinksetData Storage**: Instantly saves owner passkeys, titler badges, and RLV permission states with sub-millisecond memory execution.
* **Experience Stealth Auto-Attach Props**: Ballgags, posture locks, and heavy steel muzzle props attach seamlessly via region Experience permissions without consuming inventory attachment lag.
* **Automated Recurring Air Taxes**: Set compounding tribute debits, tax cycles, and late-fee interest penalties directly from the Domme HUD.
* **Native llDialog & Web HUD Control**: Manage your collared submissive in-world with low-lag native dialogs or launch the luxury Web App companion.

Visit Chaos Manor or check out the official [Vow Collar Web Guide](../guides/vow-collar/index.html) for setup instructions.
